description: Runtime logs of a project (summarised by default; filter by service, time window and level), or the build/deploy log of one deployment when `deployment_id` is given. Failed deploys also return a structured error with cause and fix. `kind: "audit"` returns the project's audit log (tool calls and changes, with the key and agent that made them; project owner only).

deployment_id.description: Return the build/deploy log of this deployment instead of runtime logs.

kind.description: Default: build with deployment_id, else runtime. audit lists recent tool calls and changes.

project.description: Project slug. Optional: defaults to rivtor.json in the working directory, else its folder name.

since.description: Time window such as "15m", "2h" or an ISO timestamp.

summary.description: Default true: grouped summary. false = raw lines.

name: logs
title: Logs
